sources.quote:
### Cached prompt is now available

You can now use cached prompt to save on repeated prompts. For
more info, see [models](/developers/models).
sources.supports: xAI announced cached prompt availability in May 2025, before the models.dev recording; this establishes prior feature availability but gives no Grok Vision Beta cache price.

notes: The available primary source shows prompt caching existed before the June 17 models.dev commit, but does not state whether Grok Vision Beta cache reads or writes were priced at $5/$15 per million tokens or whether the prior omission reflected zero pricing. An Internet Archive CDX request for xAI pricing snapshots failed with a connection-refused error, so no effective date or official previous cache price can be established.
